name: SwampRise (Bus Alarm)
tagline: An alarm clock that watches live bus tracking and moves your wake-up time when the bus runs late.
problem: Buses are early or late, so people either rush or wait.
solution: An ESP32 clock with a display syncs with the city's live bus data and adjusts the alarm from your stop, destination and arrival time.
demo_moment: Team-described: a delayed bus pushes the alarm later.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Integration of Hardware” among 112 submissions.
One goal: maximise sleep without missing the bus.

lessons: Local live data plus a simple device makes a sharp hardware hack.
